description: Fetch full metadata for a single YouTube video by URL or video ID — accepts /watch?v=..., /shorts/{id}, youtu.be/{id}, or the bare 11-char ID. Returns title, channel (name, handle, subscriber count, URL), view/like counts, publish date, duration, category, full description, and live flag. Pass --include-comments true to also load the comment thread (sorted by top or newest, expanded by scrolling); each comment includes author, text, like count, publish time, and reply count. Comments are capped at 100 and make the command slower. No authentication required for public videos.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Video URL (youtube.com/watch?v=..., youtube.com/shorts/..., youtu.be/...) or the bare 11-character video ID. Four accepted input forms, all normalized to the same watch page: watch?v={id}, shorts/{id}, youtu.be/{id}, bare 11-char ID.（视频 URL 或 11 位 videoId，四种输入形式：watch?v= / shorts= / youtu.be= / 裸 11 位 ID）

parameters.name: include_comments
parameters.description: Set to true to also fetch the comment thread. Default false. Comments lazy-load on scroll, so enabling this makes the command slower.（是否同时抓评论；评论滚动懒加载，开启会变慢）

parameters.name: comment_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of top-level comments to return (1-100, default 20). Only used when include_comments is true; partial=true when the thread ends early.（顶层评论条数上限，1-100，默认 20；仅开启评论时生效；流耗尽时 partial=true）

parameters.name: comment_sort
parameters.description: Comment ordering: top (default, YouTube's Top comments = 最热门/置顶) | newest (Newest first = 最新). Implemented via the comments sort menu click.（评论排序：top=最热门/置顶（默认），newest=最新）
